composition_subtypes.role: Iterate n from 2 to 40000 to find candidate n
Binary search m to satisfy floor(n/m) = sqrt(n^2 - x)

payload.core_composition_summary: Brute-force enumerate n, then binary search m to match the zero-cell count derived from x.
payload.rationale: The outer loop searches over possible n (complete search with early exit), and inner binary search finds m; both are essential and coordinated.
